# Chapter 1: The Awakening

Jake stared at the status screen hovering in his field of vision.

[Jake - Level 1 Mage]
Strength: 10
Mana: 15

"Unbelievable," he muttered, shaking his head. "It actually worked."

He took a step forward, his boots crunching on the gravel. If the system was real, then the dungeon in the cellar had to be real too. He opened the creaky wooden door. Darkness swallowed him.

"Status check," Jake said aloud. The blue screen flickered back into view. He had to level up fast if he wanted to survive the night.
